The '''1945–46 Danish 1st Division''' season was the inaugural edition of [[Danish 1st Division]] annual [[Association football|football]] competition in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams

[[Boldklubben af 1893]] successfully pursued its 1946 title.


Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1945/1946 season.
